messages:
julia: Customer 'AcmeMaps' — free-trial credits dropped ~12k overnight. They say their background ingest job called embeddings/rerank and saw retries; asking for urgent help. @billing please triage :exclamation:

sam: Can you paste the top-of-night logs or request ids?

julia: Pasting the log snippets from their support dump:
```
2026-03-12T02:03:12Z INFO job-runner starting job job_id=job_78a2
2026-03-12T02:03:35Z ERROR worker call embeddings failed status=502 req_id=req_0a1b2
2026-03-12T02:03:36Z INFO job-runner retrying job job_id=job_78a2 retry=1
2026-03-12T02:03:36Z INFO worker call embeddings succeeded req_id=req_0a1b3
```
They said payloads were identical but there was no idempotency header.

mira: Looks like two distinct req_ids but same payload. We had a brief flapping window around 02:03 (autoscaler restart) that caused 502s, which would explain the client retry. Was the client side retrying, or did our internal queue re-deliver?

nico: Customer says their background job is a simple worker that enqueues tasks into their scheduler, which calls our /v1/embeddings/batch. They rely on at-most-once semantics but IIRC our SQS-style queue is at-least-once unless dedupe keys are used.

eng-ml: Can you confirm which endpoint was hit? embeddings or rerank? Also what model?

julia: embeddings batch. model=text-embedding-3-large, batch_size=200. They attached curl example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx' \
  -d '{"inputs": [...], "model":"text-embedding-3-large"}'
```
No idempotency token in header.

sam: If worker crashes after issuing the outbound request but before persisting success, scheduler could re-enqueue. Combined with client retries from 502, that could double-charge. Need to check our outbound retry/backoff and whether we dedupe on request signature server-side.

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0312-emb-retries (linked).

mira: I pulled our request logs — we accepted both requests and generated two embedding jobs. The runtime currently de-duplicates only when an explicit idempotency key is passed. We log identical payload hashes but don't prevent cost if two separate requests arrive.

sam: So root cause likely: transient 502 -> client retry + at-least-once queue redelivery -> two distinct requests hit embeddings without idempotency key. That matches customer timeline.

julia: Customer asks for credits refund and guardrails. What do we recommend?

billing-bot: Created billing case BLG-4521 and queued refund approval.

mira: For mitigation we should: 1) offer immediate credit refund for duplicated work, 2) require/encourage idempotency headers in docs for batch endpoints, 3) add server-side soft-dedupe by payload-hash for 30s window for high-cost batch calls. I'll draft a PR.

nico: Can we confirm exact amount to refund? Customer provided bill lines: two runs of 6,000 embedding units each = 12,000 credits.

billing-bot: Refund of 12,000 credits (txn TXN-7845) issued to AcmeMaps. Pending journal entry.

sam: Created ticket RUN-2317 to change queue ack ordering: persist dedupe_key before ack so workers are idempotent. Low-risk patch, target deploy tonight. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/run/pull/423

mira: Also opened ENG-ML follow-up to add lightweight server-side dedupe cache for large batch embeddings (30s TTL).

julia: I replied to customer: refunded 12k credits, we’ve got a patch and will follow up with timeline. They asked for a temporary increase in trial cap while we validate — I approved +10k trial credits.

eng-ml: I'll monitor embedding call rates and dedupe hit/miss once patch rolls. Will post metrics in #eng-ml after deploy.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: run-service patch (RUN-2317) -> 2026-03-12T22:00:00Z; ENG-ML dedupe cache (ENG-ML-88) -> canary 2026-03-13T01:00:00Z.

julia: Customer confirmed receipt of credits and appreciates quick help :thumbsup: Closing on our side after post-deploy monitoring passes.

sam: :eyes: Will follow up if we see more duplicate billing incidents.

mira: Note for docs team — add idempotency header examples to embeddings batch quickstart.

julia: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
